question: How is the constant washing of the mouth reinterpreted in a higher spiritual sense?
premises: Washing of the mouth is mentioned as a constant act.
It is described as directed upward.
inference: The constant washing of the mouth is understood as an upward movement toward Brahman.
uncertainties: The metaphorical meaning of mouth-washing in this context is interpretive.
plain_english: O beloved, the constant washing of the mouth is directed upward toward Brahman.
